ui.the_store_shows_the_final_price_inclu.text: Toko menampilkan harga akhir, termasuk pajak, sebelum kamu membayar.

ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.en: The Training Dojo researches {arg1} (a higher Clan Keep opens more research lanes). A new level makes every warrior of that kind stronger, and costs a little more to train. Your Clan Keep level sets the highest level.
ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.text: Dojo Latihan meriset {arg1} (Benteng Klan yang lebih tinggi membuka lebih banyak jalur riset). Level baru membuat setiap prajurit jenis itu lebih kuat, dan biaya latihannya sedikit lebih mahal. Level Benteng Klan-mu menentukan level tertinggi.

ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.en: Their full training cost comes back, as far as your storage allows.
ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.text: Seluruh biaya latihannya kembali, sejauh gudangmu muat.

ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.en: There is no online account on this device: your village is kept only here. "Start a new village" below erases it; uninstalling the app or clearing this site's data removes it completely.
ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.text: Tidak ada akun online di perangkat ini: desamu hanya tersimpan di sini. "Mulai desa baru" di bawah akan menghapusnya; mencopot aplikasi atau menghapus data situs ini menghapusnya sepenuhnya.

ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.en: They are under fire! Pick the Smoke Bomb, then tap on your warriors.
ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.text: Mereka ditembaki! Pilih Bom Asap, lalu ketuk prajuritmu.

ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.en: They fight first in your next attack and take no Courtyard space.
ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.text: Mereka bertarung lebih dulu dalam seranganmu berikutnya dan tidak memakai ruang Halaman.

ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.en: They go home for good. You get back {arg1}% of their training cost, as far as your storage allows.
ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.text: Mereka pulang untuk selamanya. Kamu mendapat kembali {arg1}% biaya latihannya, sejauh gudangmu muat.

ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.en: {arg1} They walk in by themselves after a raid, or when you dismiss warriors.
ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.text: {arg1} Mereka masuk sendiri setelah serbuan, atau saat kamu membubarkan prajurit.

ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.en: They will be able to invite and to start Gang Wars. You stay in the Gang.
ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.text: Pemain itu akan bisa mengundang dan memulai Perang Geng. Kamu tetap di Geng.

ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.en: This browser can't save your village: progress is lost when this page closes. Use a normal (not private) window, or copy a save code in Settings.
ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.text: Browser ini tidak bisa menyimpan desamu: kemajuan hilang saat halaman ini ditutup. Gunakan jendela biasa (bukan privat), atau salin kode simpanan di Pengaturan.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.en: This browser may delete this village if you stay away for a while. To keep it: install Kagemura (the browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen), link a sign-in under Online play, or copy a save code.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.text: Browser ini mungkin menghapus desa ini jika kamu lama tidak datang. Untuk menyimpannya: pasang Kagemura (menu browser → Instal aplikasi atau Tambahkan ke Layar utama), tautkan cara masuk di Main online, atau salin kode simpanan.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.en: This browser may delete your village if you stay away for a week.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.text: Browser ini mungkin menghapus desamu jika kamu tidak datang selama seminggu.

ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.en: This browser mode cannot save. Your village will be lost when you close the page.
ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.text: Mode browser ini tidak bisa menyimpan. Desamu akan hilang saat kamu menutup halaman.

ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.en: This device could not store your latest actions (storage full or blocked). They are being sent to the server now; free some space to keep playing offline safely.
ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.text: Perangkat ini tidak bisa menyimpan tindakan terbarumu (penyimpanan penuh atau diblokir). Tindakan itu sedang dikirim ke server; kosongkan sedikit ruang agar tetap aman bermain offline.

ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.en: This device still holds your online account on
ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.text: Perangkat ini masih menyimpan akun online-mu di

ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.en: This device will play the account linked to that sign-in. If its village is kept on the server, it replaces the village here, which stays as a backup in Settings. Your current online account is not deleted.
ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.text: Perangkat ini akan memainkan akun yang tertaut ke cara masuk itu. Jika desanya disimpan di server, desa itu menggantikan desa di sini, yang tetap menjadi cadangan di Pengaturan. Akun online-mu saat ini tidak dihapus.

ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.en: This is a {arg1} server for testing: villages and purchases here are separate from the real game.
ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.text: Ini adalah server {arg1} untuk pengujian: desa dan pembelian di sini terpisah dari game sungguhan.

ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.en: This is the testing sandbox: a separate practice village with online play off. Skipping time moves the sandbox clock ahead for good; your real village is never affected.
ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.text: Ini adalah sandbox pengujian: desa latihan terpisah dengan main online mati. Melompati waktu memajukan jam sandbox secara permanen; desa aslimu tidak pernah terpengaruh.

ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.en: This starts a new village that is kept on the server. The village on this device stays as a backup you can restore in Settings.
ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.text: Ini memulai desa baru yang disimpan di server. Desa di perangkat ini tetap menjadi cadangan yang bisa kamu pulihkan di Pengaturan.

ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.en: Time skips and test purchases live in a separate testing sandbox, so they can never change your real village or online play.
ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.text: Lompatan waktu dan pembelian uji coba ada di sandbox pengujian terpisah, jadi tidak pernah bisa mengubah desa aslimu atau main online.

ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.en: Time until everyone who fits in the Squad Courtyards has finished
ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.text: Waktu sampai semua yang muat di Halaman Regu selesai

ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.en: Train some warriors first: duels use your army (none are spent).
ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.text: Latih beberapa prajurit dulu: duel memakai pasukanmu (tidak ada yang habis).

ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.en: Train some warriors, then save the mix here to refill it later.
ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.text: Latih beberapa prajurit, lalu simpan komposisinya di sini untuk diisi ulang nanti.

ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.en: Trained ahead. They join your army when the Squad Courtyards have room. Jade can't finish them until then.
ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.text: Dilatih lebih dulu. Mereka bergabung dengan pasukanmu saat Halaman Regu punya ruang. Sampai saat itu Giok tidak bisa menyelesaikannya.

ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.en: Training opens as soon as the work is done.

ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.en: Two to four friends against another Gang of the same size: 2 hours to prepare, then 22 hours with 2 attacks each. Strike alone, or relay: a relay strike starts from half the damage of your Gang’s last strike on that base (defenders patch up in between). No honor is won or lost; everyone gets a chest.
ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.text: Dua sampai empat teman melawan Geng lain yang sama besar: 2 jam untuk bersiap, lalu 22 jam dengan masing-masing 2 serangan. Serang sendiri, atau estafet: serangan estafet dimulai dari separuh kerusakan serangan terakhir Geng-mu pada markas itu (pihak bertahan sempat memperbaiki di antaranya). Tidak ada kehormatan yang didapat atau hilang; semua orang mendapat peti.

ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.en: Until the season ends: {pct}% faster builds, the {arg1} look and bigger rewards on every tier. Rewards you already earned unlock right away.
ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.text: Sampai musim berakhir: pembangunan {pct}% lebih cepat, tampilan {arg1}, dan hadiah lebih besar di setiap tingkat. Hadiah yang sudah kamu raih langsung terbuka.

ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.en: Update Kagemura from {arg1}, then open it again.
ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.text: Perbarui Kagemura dari {arg1}, lalu buka lagi.

ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.en: Upgrading your Clan Keep to level {arg1} unlocks:
ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.text: Meningkatkan Benteng Klan-mu ke level {arg1} membuka:

ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.en: Village map. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a building to select it. Every action is also on the buttons around the map.
ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.text: Peta desa. Seret untuk melihat sekeliling, cubit atau gulir untuk memperbesar, ketuk bangunan untuk memilihnya. Setiap tindakan juga ada di tombol di sekitar peta.

ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.en: Warriors need two buildings: the Dojo trains them and the Courtyard houses them.
ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.text: Prajurit butuh dua bangunan: Dojo melatih mereka dan Halaman menampung mereka.

ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.en: We keep only an age group on this device and our server, never your date of birth. Please answer honestly: our support team can correct a mistake.
ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.text: Kami hanya menyimpan kelompok usia di perangkat ini dan server kami, tidak pernah tanggal lahirmu. Jawablah dengan jujur: tim dukungan kami bisa memperbaiki kesalahan.

ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.en: When the game hits an error, it sends the error message, where in the code it happened, the game version and the platform, to help fix it. It does not add your name, Player ID, village or chat, but an error message can sometimes include text the game was working on.
ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.text: Saat game mengalami galat, game mengirim pesan galat, lokasinya di kode, versi game, dan platform, untuk membantu memperbaikinya. Namamu, ID Pemain, desa, atau obrolan tidak ditambahkan, tapi pesan galat kadang bisa berisi teks yang sedang diproses game.

ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.en: When the last of this stack finishes, after everyone ahead of it
ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.text: Saat yang terakhir dari tumpukan ini selesai, setelah semua yang ada di depannya

ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.en: Where you live, Google Play confirms ages for apps. Open the Play Store app, verify your age there, then come back: online play and purchases unlock once Google Play shares your age group.
ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.text: Di wilayahmu, Google Play mengonfirmasi usia untuk aplikasi. Buka aplikasi Play Store, verifikasi usiamu di sana, lalu kembali: main online dan pembelian terbuka setelah Google Play membagikan kelompok usiamu.

ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.en: Where you live, the App Store confirms ages for apps. Confirm your age in your Apple Account settings, then come back.
ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.text: Di wilayahmu, App Store mengonfirmasi usia untuk aplikasi. Konfirmasi usiamu di pengaturan Akun Apple, lalu kembali.

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_64ffa21978.en: Who can find me by name
ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_64ffa21978.text: Siapa yang bisa menemukanku lewat nama

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_ed481ead6d.en: Who can find me by name
ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_ed481ead6d.text: Siapa yang bisa menemukanku lewat nama

ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.en: Win raids to earn honor; lose it when your attacks fail or when raiders beat your village. More honor bring tougher opponents with more loot.
ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.text: Menangkan serbuan untuk mendapat kehormatan; kehormatan berkurang saat seranganmu gagal atau saat penyerbu mengalahkan desamu. Kehormatan lebih tinggi mendatangkan lawan lebih tangguh dengan jarahan lebih banyak.

ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.en: You are about to spend {arg1} of real money. Make sure a parent or guardian says it's OK.
ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.text: Kamu akan membelanjakan {arg1} uang sungguhan. Pastikan orang tua atau wali mengizinkan.

ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.en: You are in the top league!

ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.en: You are playing on your own: opponents, raiders and your Alliance are friendly bots (always labelled as computer players). To raid real players and join real Alliances, enter a Kagemura: Ninja Clans server address under Advanced, below.
ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.text: Kamu bermain sendiri: lawan, penyerbu, dan Aliansi-mu adalah bot ramah (selalu diberi label pemain komputer). Untuk menyerbu pemain sungguhan dan bergabung dengan Aliansi sungguhan, masukkan alamat server Kagemura: Ninja Clans di bagian Lanjutan, di bawah.

ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.en: You can add each other again later.
ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.text: Kalian bisa saling menambahkan lagi nanti.

ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.en: You can found or join a Gang again after 24 hours.
ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.text: Kamu bisa mendirikan atau bergabung dengan Geng lagi setelah 24 jam.

ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.en: You can join another Alliance straight away. Warriors in your Alliance Lodge stay with you.
ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.text: Kamu bisa langsung bergabung dengan Aliansi lain. Prajurit di Balai Aliansi-mu tetap bersamamu.

ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.en: You can keep {arg1} saved armies. Delete one to save this army.
ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.text: Kamu bisa menyimpan {arg1} pasukan. Hapus satu untuk menyimpan pasukan ini.

ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.en: You finished the training. Please enter your year of birth: it sets the right protections for your age (spending limits, offers, and for online play who can find you and how you chat).
ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.text: Kamu sudah menyelesaikan latihan. Masukkan tahun lahirmu: ini menentukan perlindungan yang tepat untuk usiamu (batas pengeluaran, penawaran, dan untuk main online: siapa yang bisa menemukanmu dan cara kamu mengobrol).

ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.en: You have not cleared a tier yet.
ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.text: Kamu belum menuntaskan satu tingkat pun.

ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.en: You have the premium Season Scroll this season.
ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.text: Kamu punya Gulungan Musim premium musim ini.

ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.en: You joined after this war started: cheer your Gang on.
ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.text: Kamu bergabung setelah perang ini dimulai: dukung Geng-mu.

ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.en: You left a Gang lately: you can found or join one in {arg1}.
ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.text: Kamu baru saja keluar dari Geng: kamu bisa mendirikan atau bergabung dengan Geng dalam {arg1}.

ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.en: You'll get back {arg1}% of what you paid.
ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.text: Kamu akan mendapat kembali {arg1}% dari yang kamu bayar.

ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.en: You stop being friends, and neither of you can find or ask the other.
ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.text: Kalian berhenti berteman, dan tidak ada yang bisa menemukan atau mengajak yang lain.

ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.en: Your age group can only be made stricter here. To correct it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.text: Kelompok usiamu hanya bisa dibuat lebih ketat di sini. Untuk memperbaikinya, hubungi dukungan dari Pengaturan → Privasi dan bantuan.

ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.en: Your Alliance is matched with a real Alliance of similar size and strength, or with a band of wild bots when none is free. Only members who were in the Alliance when the raid starts take part.
ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.text: Aliansi-mu dipasangkan dengan Aliansi sungguhan yang ukuran dan kekuatannya mirip, atau dengan sekelompok bot liar jika tidak ada yang tersedia. Hanya anggota yang sudah ada di Aliansi saat serbuan dimulai yang ikut.

ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.en: Your Clan Keep is at the highest level available right now.
ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.text: Benteng Klan-mu sudah di level tertinggi yang tersedia saat ini.

ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.en: Your current layout is now your duel layout.
ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.text: Tata letakmu saat ini sekarang menjadi tata letak duel.

ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.en: Your current village on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.text: Desamu saat ini di perangkat ini akan dihapus. Ini tidak bisa dibatalkan.

ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.en: Your earlier village is back. The one you were playing is kept in Settings.
ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.text: Desa sebelumnya sudah kembali. Desa yang tadi kamu mainkan disimpan di Pengaturan.

ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack! when you are ready.
ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.text: Serbuan pertamamu. Ketuk Serang! saat kamu siap.

ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.en: Your friend code always works: share it only with people you want to add.
ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.text: Kode temanmu selalu berlaku: bagikan hanya kepada orang yang ingin kamu tambahkan.

ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your new village is kept on the server.

ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.en: Your {arg1} on {arg2} was interrupted and has been played out: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. See the battle log.
ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.text: {arg1}-mu di {arg2} terputus dan sudah dimainkan sampai selesai: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. Lihat log pertempuran.

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.en: Your online account was deleted. Restarting offline…
ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.text: Akun online-mu sudah dihapus. Memulai ulang secara offline…

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance membership, chat messages and warrior requests are deleted from the server now. Online attacks still waiting for the server become practice results. Online play turns off on this device; your village stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Nama pemain, markas yang dibagikan, keanggotaan Aliansi, pesan obrolan, dan permintaan prajuritmu sekarang dihapus dari server. Serangan online yang masih menunggu server menjadi hasil latihan. Main online dimatikan di perangkat ini; desamu tetap ada. Ini tidak bisa dibatalkan.

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance and Gang membership, friends, chat messages and any village kept on {arg1} are deleted from that server now. Online play stays off; your village on this device stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Nama pemain, markas yang dibagikan, keanggotaan Aliansi dan Geng, teman, pesan obrolan, dan desa apa pun yang disimpan di {arg1} sekarang dihapus dari server itu. Main online tetap mati; desamu di perangkat ini tetap ada. Ini tidak bisa dibatalkan.

ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.en: Your purchase is here, but this device could not save it (storage full?). Free some space: it stays open in the store and is delivered again if needed.
ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.text: Pembelianmu sudah ada, tapi perangkat ini tidak bisa menyimpannya (penyimpanan penuh?). Kosongkan sedikit ruang: pembelian ini tetap terbuka di toko dan akan dikirim lagi jika perlu.

ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.en: Your remaining warriors go back home. You keep any loot you already won.
ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.text: Prajuritmu yang tersisa pulang. Jarahan yang sudah kamu dapat tetap milikmu.

ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.en: Your stars count toward the Alliance War.

ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.en: Your Training Dojo trains {arg1}× faster than a level 1 Dojo.
ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.text: Dojo Latihan-mu melatih {arg1}× lebih cepat daripada Dojo level 1.

ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.en: Your village could not be saved ({arg1}). Free some device storage, and copy a save code in Settings to keep it safe.
ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.text: Desamu tidak bisa disimpan ({arg1}). Kosongkan sedikit penyimpanan perangkat, dan salin kode simpanan di Pengaturan agar tetap aman.

ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.en: Your village is kept on the server: every change to its resources, buildings, army and research is checked there, so it cannot be lost with this device. What you do is sent as you play; while offline it waits and goes when you reconnect.
ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.text: Desamu disimpan di server: setiap perubahan sumber daya, bangunan, pasukan, dan riset diperiksa di sana, jadi tidak bisa hilang bersama perangkat ini. Apa yang kamu lakukan dikirim selama kamu bermain; saat offline, semuanya menunggu dan dikirim saat kamu tersambung lagi.

ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your village is now kept on the server.

ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.en: Your village is on the server now. {arg1} could not be matched to a purchase we checked, so it is held for review: contact support from Settings. Your old village is kept as a backup.
ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.text: Desamu sekarang ada di server. {arg1} tidak bisa dicocokkan dengan pembelian yang kami periksa, jadi ditahan untuk ditinjau: hubungi dukungan dari Pengaturan. Desa lamamu disimpan sebagai cadangan.

ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.en: Your village is saved, and your Artisans keep working while you are away.
ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.text: Desamu tersimpan, dan para Perajin-mu terus bekerja selama kamu pergi.

ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.en: Your village moves to the server as it is, if it is a village its Keep could really have. From then on every change is checked there, and you can play it on other devices by linking a sign-in.
ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.text: Desamu dipindahkan ke server apa adanya, jika desa itu memang mungkin dimiliki dengan Benteng-nya. Sejak itu setiap perubahan diperiksa di sana, dan kamu bisa memainkannya di perangkat lain dengan menautkan cara masuk.

ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.en: Your village saves automatically on this device. To move it to another device, copy a save code here and load it there.
ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.text: Desamu tersimpan otomatis di perangkat ini. Untuk memindahkannya ke perangkat lain, salin kode simpanan di sini dan muat di sana.

ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.en: Your village was opened in another tab or window, and only one can save it. Your progress is safe there.
ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.text: Desamu dibuka di tab atau jendela lain, dan hanya satu yang bisa menyimpannya. Kemajuanmu aman di sana.

ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.en: Your village was saved by a newer version of Kagemura, so this version cannot open it. It is safe and unchanged.
ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.text: Desamu disimpan oleh versi Kagemura yang lebih baru, jadi versi ini tidak bisa membukanya. Desamu aman dan tidak berubah.

ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.en: Your war base now matches your village.
ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.text: Markas perangmu sekarang sama dengan desamu.

extra.a0ce7f563a.en: Towers in a wide ring cover each other: jam one, smoke your squad as it reaches the next, break in through the gap.
extra.a0ce7f563a.text: Menara dalam lingkaran lebar saling melindungi: lumpuhkan satu, beri asap pada regumu saat mencapai menara berikutnya, lalu masuk lewat celahnya.

extra.8e339fb4f5.en: Two gates funnel warriors onto hidden traps: choose a gate, or go over the wall.

extra.ab7daf1525.en: Buildings spread wide with no walls: fast Shinobi and Tunnel Runners clear it quickly.
extra.ab7daf1525.text: Bangunan tersebar luas tanpa tembok: Shinobi yang cepat dan Pelari Terowongan bisa membersihkannya dengan cepat.
